description: Flip the selected image horizontally or vertically. Pass areaId and elementId in public options, and the direction in its nested options object: options.options.direction = horizontal or vertical.

options.description: Existing arguments; advanced fields/aliases remain accepted. Catalogue/session results include the full designArgumentSchema.
Native image options: flip direction=horizontal|vertical; native generation prompt, mode, singleResult, imageCount. This object is public options.options.

placement.description: x/y are normalized centres. coordinateSpace=print_area uses garment print bounds; otherwise stage. width/height use stage unless dimensionSpace=print_area.

requestId.description: Generate a UUID for a new action. Reuse it only for retrying/polling that same action and payload. A new user edit needs a new UUID.

sessionToken.description: The private expiring capability returned by start_design_session. Do not publish it.

subject.description: The exact subject returned by start_design_session.

name: flip_image
title: Flip an image
